notes.title: Lost Luminosity
notes.content:
[h1][b]Lost Luminosity - A new horror game![/b][/h1]

[b]Guys, many thanks to everyone who has already added it to the wishlist! 

Your support is incredibly important to me and I really appreciate your interest in my project! It is thanks to you that I continue to work on the game and try to make it even better. 

Thank you![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3603100/Lost_Luminosity/

notes.title: Patch 1.9.4.0
notes.content:
1. Optimization of actions when searching for objects

2. Added more visual cues

3. Increased range and intensity of the glow stick light

notes.title: Patch 1.8.4.0
notes.content:

2. Visual bugs have been removed.

3. Optimized some textures on the third location
